description:
O'Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are pleased to offer for sale this beautiful, detached home ideally positioned in the small residential enclave of Clybaun Close. 

Clybaun Close is a quaint cul-de-sac development comprising of just four detached properties with residential parking & encompassed by mature landscaped greenery. 

Originally constructed in 2007, no.2 Clybaun Close is presented in excellent condition throughout having been well maintained & enhanced by the current owners. 

The property offers well proportioned & spacious accommodation with approximately 136.7 sq.m over two stories. 

The ground floor is arranged between a large welcoming hall leading to the front living room with inserted stove & double doors leading to the open plan kitchen-dining area with modern fittings.

The back of the house is arranged between a separate utility, downstairs bathroom & a downstairs bedrooms. 

Upstairs consists of three large bedrooms, two availing of their own en-suites, and a main family bathroom. An attic hatch & stira stairs via the spacious landing provides access to the attic space offering plenty of storage space. 

Externally, no.2 Clybaun Close boasts a beautiful private garden with manicured planting, patio space & surrounded by mature greenery. 

Clybaun Close is a popular residential enclave comprising of all owner occupied residences. 

Neatly set back off the Clybaun Road in Knocknacarra, the area is popular due to the host of amenities within walking distance such as Tescos, Clybaun Stores, Tom Sheridans Bar & Gateway Retail Park. 

Regular transport links give ease of access to Galway & City Centre, whilst several outdoor landmarks are within easy reach including McGrath's Field & Cappagh Playing Fields. 

No.2 Clybaun Close is a turn-key condition property with an abundance of space giving a buyer the opportunity to secure their new home in a friendly environment & ideal location.

Viewing is highly recommended & guaranteed not to disappoint.
